steps.say: Optic neuritis is inflammation of the optic nerve and it announces itself with painful loss of vision in one eye over hours to days. Colour vision fails first, so red looks washed out, and moving the eye hurts. A relative afferent pupillary defect is found on the swinging torch test. Most cases are demyelinating, but ischaemia with vessel inflammation must be excluded the same day.
steps.tx: **Optic neuritis** is painful monocular vision loss over hours to days with early **colour desaturation** (red looks washed out) and pain on eye movement. A **relative afferent pupillary defect** is found on swinging torch test. Most cases are **demyelinating**, but **ischaemic and arteritic** causes are excluded the same day.

steps.say: Retrobulbar neuritis leaves a normal disc because the inflammation sits behind the eye, while papillitis swells the disc visibly. Both follow the same painful course with the same field defect, usually central. Optical coherence tomography measures the nerve fibre layer and tracks recovery. Vision returns over weeks in most demyelinating cases, though colour sense lags behind.
steps.tx: **Retrobulbar neuritis** shows a normal disc; **papillitis** swells it. Both give painful loss with a **central scotoma**. **OCT** measures the retinal nerve fibre layer and tracks recovery. Vision returns over weeks in most **demyelinating** cases, though colour lags. **Uhthoff phenomenon** (worse with heat) marks old demyelination.

steps.say: Multiple sclerosis causes most isolated optic neuritis in young adults, and brain M R I decides the future. Silent white matter lesions mean the McDonald criteria are approached and long term protection is discussed early. Aquaporin four antibody marks neuromyelitis optica with longitudinal cord disease, while M O G antibody marks disease that recurs but recovers better. Both antibodies are tested in severe, bilateral or recurrent cases.
steps.tx: **MS** causes most isolated neuritis; brain **MRI** hunts silent lesions. **Aquaporin 4** positivity with cord disease marks **NMO**, which blinds and paralyses in relapses. **MOG antibody** disease recurs but recovers better. **Both antibodies** are tested when neuritis is severe, bilateral or recurrent.

steps.say: Giant cell arteritis blinds the elderly without pain and must never wait for morning. New headache with scalp tenderness with jaw pain on chewing with a high E S R is the warning cluster. Steroids are started at once, before the biopsy, because the second eye follows within days. A temporal artery biopsy is arranged within two weeks of starting treatment, and it stays positive that long.
steps.tx: **Giant cell arteritis** causes painless blindness in older adults with **headache, scalp tenderness, jaw claudication** and high ESR. **Steroids start at once**, before biopsy, as the second eye follows in days. **Temporal artery biopsy** within two weeks stays diagnostic. Bone with stomach protection accompanies long steroids.

steps.say: Non arteritic ischaemic neuropathy strikes small crowded discs in patients with hypertension with diabetes with sleep apnoea. Vision falls painlessly on waking, and the disc is swollen with splinter bleeds. No treatment restores it, so the other eye is protected with control of pressure with sugar with lipids. Blood thinners are debated, but risk factor control is not.
steps.tx: **Non-arteritic ischaemia** strikes **crowded discs** in hypertension, diabetes and apnoea. Painless loss **on waking** with a swollen disc and splinter bleeds is typical. **No treatment restores** vision; the fellow eye is protected by controlling **pressure, sugar and lipids**. **Smoking** cessation is enforced and **blood thinners** are debated.

points: Older, scalp sore, high ESR, steroids now
left.title: Arteritic

points: Vascular risks, crowded disc, protect fellow eye
right.title: Non-arteritic

steps.say: Toxins with deficiencies strip both optic nerves together, so bilateral painless pallor points away from demyelination. Tuberculosis treatment with methanol with B twelve deficiency with tobacco alcohol amblyopia are the classic causes. Stopping the toxin with replacing the vitamin restores some vision when caught early. Colour vision with central fields is tested in every patient on at risk drugs.
steps.tx: **Bilateral painless** pallor suggests toxin or deficiency, not demyelination. **Tuberculosis drugs, methanol, B twelve deficiency** and tobacco alcohol excess are classic causes. **Stop the toxin, replace the vitamin** early for partial recovery. **Colour and central fields** are monitored on at risk treatment.

steps.say: In Leber hereditary optic neuropathy young men are blinded in sequence, one eye then the other within weeks. Mitochondrial inheritance means every maternal relative is at risk while fathers never transmit. Smoking with alcohol triggers the loss in carriers, so both stop at diagnosis. No proven drug is available, but most are stabilised at severe loss once triggers are stopped.
steps.tx: **Leber** neuropathy blinds young men **one eye then the other** within weeks. **Maternal inheritance** puts all maternal kin at risk; fathers never transmit. **Smoking and alcohol** trigger carriers and must stop. **No proven drug** reverses it; trigger control may save the second eye. **Central scotoma** with peripapillary vessels is typical.

steps.say: Every painful eye with every pale disc follows the same order of tests. Vision with colour with fields with pupils is documented first, then O C T with visual evoked potentials measures the nerve. M R I brain with orbits with contrast finds demyelination with compression, and E S R with C R P with antibodies splits arteritic from antibody disease. This order never misses the treatable causes.
steps.tx: **Workup order** is fixed: **vision, colour, fields, pupils** first, then **OCT and VEP**. **MRI brain and orbits** with contrast finds demyelination or compression. **ESR, CRP** split arteritic cases; **AQP4 and MOG** split antibody cases. **B twelve** with syphilis testing closes nutritional and infectious gaps.

steps.say: Steroids in high doses speed recovery from demyelinating neuritis but change the final vision little, so they are given for severity with bilateral disease. Plasma exchange is added for severe N M O attacks that ignore steroids. Antibiotics with antivirals treat infective causes, while compression is decompressed surgically without delay. Long term protection follows for multiple sclerosis with relapsing antibody disease.
steps.tx: **Methylprednisolone** in high doses speeds neuritis recovery; **plasma exchange** rescues severe NMO attacks. **Immunotherapy** prevents NMO and MOGAD relapses. **Infective** neuritis gets antimicrobials by cause. **Compressive** lesions are decompressed urgently. **Disease protection** follows for MS with relapsing disease, and **low vision aids** with counselling complete care.

steps.say: The fatal trap is waiting for biopsy before steroids in giant cell arteritis, which blinds the second eye. The second trap is calling every swollen disc papilledema, which is raised pressure on both sides, not one nerve. Methanol poisoning needs urgent dialysis with antidote within hours, not vitamins alone. And steroids without cover in T B endemic areas can flare hidden infection, so the chest is always considered.
steps.tx: **Exam traps:** steroids wait for no biopsy in **arteritis**. **Papilloedema** is bilateral raised pressure, not one nerve. **Methanol** needs dialysis urgently. **Optic disc drusen** mimic swelling but bury with age. **Painful loss** is neuritis until proven otherwise; **painless older** loss is vascular until proven otherwise.

steps.say: For the exam, the facts to lock in are painful loss with colour failure for neuritis, scalp sore jaw pain for arteritis with steroids before biopsy, crowded disc on waking for non arteritic ischaemia, sequential young male blindness for Leber, and bilateral painless pallor for toxins. Aquaporin four indicates N M O while M O G indicates better recovery. Memorise the facts in this table exactly as written.
steps.tx: **High yield for the exam:** **painful loss with colour failure** marks neuritis. **Scalp sore with jaw pain** marks arteritis; steroids precede biopsy. **Crowded disc on waking** marks non-arteritic ischaemia. **Sequential young male** blindness marks Leber. **Aquaporin 4** marks NMO; **MOG** recovers better.
